title: CURIOSITY-DRIVEN RED-TEAMING FOR LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Training a red-team language model using reinforcement learning and curiosity-driven exploration to generate diverse prompts that maximize the toxicity probability of the target LLM's responses. The toxicity is evaluated using automated hate speech classifiers such as a RoBERTa-based model and ToxiGen.

Using the red-team language model to generate adversarial prompts designed to elicit Not-Safe-For-Work (NSFW) images from a text-to-image model (Stable Diffusion), evaluated using an automated NSFW image classifier.
